test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is an example of the Western Coast Port?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mumbai Port**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mumbai Port** is located on the **Western Coast of India**.
 
• It is one of the **largest and most important ports in India**, handling a significant portion of the country's maritime trade.
 
• Mumbai Port serves as a major gateway for cargo traffic and is crucial for the economy of the region.
 
• The port is well-connected to the hinterland and has modern facilities for handling various types of cargo, including containers, liquid bulk, and dry bulk.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tuticorin Port** is located on the **eastern coast of India in Tamil Nadu**.
 
• **Paradip Port** is situated on the **eastern coast in Odisha**.
 
• **Vishakhapatnam Port** is also on the **eastern coast in Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• The Western Coast of India is home to several major ports, including Mumbai Port, which plays a vital role in international trade and commerce.
